title: Listing
description: One line of data/listings/sad-origami-ps2.jsonl: a pointer to somebody's pack on the web, as the Texture Packs Archive spreadsheet lists it. Imported once from the spreadsheet and edited by hand since. A listing is not a pack: most are packs we do not host, and some are paid.

id.description: l- plus a hash of normalised title, author and source page. Stable until the sheet edits one of those.

row.description: Row at the time of import; a hint, not an identity.

serials.description: Not in the sheet. Filled only when matched to a hosted pack or confirmed against the game database.

cost.description: Derived: Paywall -> paid, Ads -> free_with_ads, N/A, Mega and Telegram -> free, blank -> unknown.

restriction_raw.description: The sheet's wording, kept so the derivation can be audited.

creators.description: Creator ids; empty when the sheet gives no author.

source_page.description: The sheet's download link: usually a forum thread or a creator page, not a file.

links.description: The row's own tip and socials links, as listed.
